config.name: mailFrom
config.label: Mail From Address
config.description: Mail will be sent from this address

config.name: username
config.label: SMTP Username
config.description: For authentication with the mail server

config.name: password
config.label: SMTP Password
config.description: For authentication with the mail server

config.name: secure
config.label: Enable SSL/TLS
config.description: Enable secure mail transport. Use for implicit TLS ports such as 465; leave off for port 587, which upgrades to TLS via STARTTLS.

config.name: allowSelfSigned
config.label: Allow Self-Signed Certificates
config.description: Skip certificate validation for the mail server. Only enable for an internal relay using a self-signed certificate - it allows anyone who can intercept the connection to read your SMTP password.

aliasConfig.name: enable
aliasConfig.label: Enable
aliasConfig.description: Enable sending messages that match this alias via SMTP

aliasConfig.name: mailto
aliasConfig.label: Mail Recipients
aliasConfig.description: Recipients for this capcode, comma separated
